provenance.irf: Average what-if response across countries: the mean, over the countries observed in the panel's last year, of the change in the forecast median of each target after a large move in one node (its latest value moved by 0.5 standard deviations of its level), up ('shocks') or down ('shocks_fall'); p10 / p90 keys give the spread across countries. From the forecaster of record, each horizon forecast directly. A statement about prediction, not a causal effect. Units: SD of the target's level.
provenance.counterfactual_trajectories: What-if responses from the forecaster of record. Baseline: the published forecast median for this country, issued from its last observed year, at 1, 3, 5 and 10 years. Shocked: the forecast median after a LARGE MOVE in one node: its latest value moved by 0.5 standard deviations of its level, up ('shocks') or down ('shocks_fall'), everything else as observed. Structural nodes are not shocked. Each horizon is forecast directly. A response is the change in the forecast when one variable is different today: a statement about prediction, not an estimate of a causal effect. Levels in standard deviations of each node (mean and SD over all country-years of the panel).
